name: Falsehood
overview: Scripture reveals falsehood as a fundamental element of human sinfulness and deception, beginning with Satan's lie to Eve that she would not surely die and that she could become like God (Genesis 3:4-5). This pattern continues with Adam and Eve attempting to evade responsibility by blaming each other and the serpent (Genesis 3:12-13), and Cain's denial of his brother's whereabouts (Genesis 4:9). Even the patriarchs engaged in falsehood, as Abraham and Sarah concealed their relationship to protect themselves (Genesis 12:11), illustrating how deceit distorts trust and accountability in human relationships.
